glyph_geometry: Common row cap/ascender height from source H/h/0; source-relative x-height and descenders retained. Baseline is the exclusive bottom of H/h/0 white strokes.
limitations: All splits reuse the same 62 glyph templates from 3 source image(s).
Disjoint scene hashes and random seeds do not create independent font or drawing samples.
Synthetic metrics cannot establish performance on unseen real CAD drawings.
No punctuation or other fonts are represented.
Demo image also reuses the training glyph templates.
